title: El-Sayed Says Trump, Vance, Rogers Have No Answers
description:
Michigan Democratic US Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed says President Donald Trump is Mike Rogers' "Daddy." El-Sayed has been critical of Rogers, his Republican opponent, for bowing to Trump's wishes. El-Sayed also talks about healthcare and the cost of living with Kailey Leinz on "Balance of Power."
